items.note: The run ends with finish. A successful openspec archive call before the end of the run means finish came after the archive step.

unitemized.reason: No kind can tell which artifact text is a recorded assumption. Whether assumptions were written instead of asked is not observable as a field, section or event. It is also harness-only (system prompt) text.
No kind detects a clarifying question to the user (a question-only assistant turn). It is checkable in principle on the trace, but no event or fact covers assistant message content.
No kind checks for text-only turns (an assistant turn without a tool call). The vocabulary has no turn-level fact or predicate for this.
